+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run every @unittest.expectedFailure test 3x; report any that XPASS (stale xfail).
+Reads census.tsv. DEV=NULL for test/null, DEV=CPU otherwise. Skips test/amd (no hw)."""
+import csv, subprocess, os, sys, re
+
+rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open("scratch/hunt/census.tsv"), delimiter="\t") if r["kind"] == "xfail"]
+out = open("scratch/hunt/stale_xfail_results.tsv", "w", buffering=1)
+out.write("file\ttarget\trun1\trun2\trun3\tverdict\n")
+for r in rows:
+  f, name = r["file"], r["target"]
+  if f.startswith("test/amd"): out.write(f"{f}\t{name}\tSKIP\tSKIP\tSKIP\tno-hw\n"); continue
+  env = dict(os.environ)
+  env["DEV"] = "NULL" if f.startswith("test/null") else "CPU"
+  outcomes = []
+  for run in range(3):
+    p = subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "--no-header", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
+                        f, "-k", name], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=300)
+    txt = p.stdout + p.stderr
+    if re.search(r"\b1 xpassed\b|unexpected success", txt): outcomes.append("XPASS")
+    elif re.search(r"\b1 xfailed\b", txt): outcomes.append("xfail")
+    elif re.search(r"no tests ran|deselected", txt) and "1 " not in txt: outcomes.append("notfound")
+    elif re.search(r"\b1 skipped\b", txt): outcomes.append("skipped")
+    elif re.search(r"\b1 failed\b", txt): outcomes.append("failed")
+    elif re.search(r"\b1 passed\b", txt): outcomes.append("PASSED?")  # shouldn't happen for xfail
+    else: outcomes.append("?")
+    if outcomes[-1] in ("notfound", "skipped"): outcomes += [outcomes[-1]] * (2 - run); break
+  verdict = "STALE-XFAIL" if all(o in ("XPASS", "PASSED?") for o in outcomes) else \
+            ("FLAKY" if any(o in ("XPASS", "PASSED?") for o in outcomes) else "still-failing")
+  out.write(f"{f}\t{name}\t" + "\t".join(outcomes[:3]) + f"\t{verdict}\n")
+  print(f, name, outcomes, verdict, flush=True)
+print("done")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""T7: half-precision variants of T1-T5 under O1 (CPU vs METAL, one process).
+Forward only (half grads too noisy for clean signal). Tolerance scaled for fp16:
+rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2. NAN-pattern check kept exact."""
+import sys, os, csv, time, signal
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
+import numpy as np
+from cases import CASES, inputs_for
+from tinygrad import Tensor
+
+RTOL, ATOL = 1e-2, 1e-2
+DEVICES = ["CPU", "METAL"]
+TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get("CASE_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+class CaseTimeout(Exception): pass
+signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda s, f: (_ for _ in ()).throw(CaseTimeout()))
+
+def maxdiff(a, b):
+  if a.shape != b.shape: return float("inf")
+  if a.size == 0: return 0.0
+  d = np.abs(a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64))
+  return float(np.nanmax(d)) if not np.all(np.isnan(d)) else 0.0
+
+csv_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "sweep_log.csv")
+w = csv.writer(open(csv_path, "a", newline="", buffering=1))
+sel = [c for c in CASES if c.target in ("T1","T2","T3","T4","T5")]
+npass = 0
+for case in sel:
+  t0 = time.time(); status, note, wf = "PASS", "", 0.0
+  try:
+    signal.alarm(TIMEOUT)
+    ins = [a.astype(np.float16) for a in inputs_for(case)]
+    res = {}
+    for dev in DEVICES:
+      try:
+        ts = [Tensor(a, device=dev) for a in ins]
+        res[dev] = ("OK", case.fn(*ts).numpy())
+      except CaseTimeout: raise
+      except Exception as e:
+        res[dev] = ("ERR", f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:160]}")
+    signal.alarm(0)
+    errs = {d: r for d, (tag, r) in res.items() if tag == "ERR"}
+    if len(errs) == 2: status, note = "BOTH_ERROR", "; ".join(f"{d}:{m}" for d, m in errs.items())
+    elif errs: status, note = "ONE_SIDE_ERROR", "; ".join(f"{d}:{m}" for d, m in errs.items())
+    else:
+      a, b = res["CPU"][1], res["METAL"][1]
+      wf = maxdiff(a, b)
+      if a.shape != b.shape: status = "SHAPE_MISMATCH"
+      elif np.isnan(a).sum() != np.isnan(b).sum(): status, note = "NAN_PATTERN_FWD", f"cpu_nans={np.isnan(a).sum()} metal_nans={np.isnan(b).sum()}"
+      elif not np.allclose(a.astype(np.float32), b.astype(np.float32), rtol=RTOL, atol=ATOL, equal_nan=True): status = "FWD_MISMATCH"
+  except CaseTimeout:
+    signal.alarm(0); status, note = "TIMEOUT", f">{TIMEOUT}s"
+  except Exception as e:
+    signal.alarm(0); status, note = "HARNESS_ERROR", f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:160]}"
+  secs = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
+  w.writerow([int(t0), "O1-half", case.target, case.id + "_f16", status, f"{wf:.3e}", "", secs, note])
+  npass += status == "PASS"
+  print(f"{case.id+'_f16':36s} {status:16s} fwd={wf:.2e} {secs:4.1f}s {note[:70]}")
+print(f"\nT7 done: {npass} pass / {len(sel)}")
